run_eval_det_cls: run eval_det_cls to compute precision, recall, and average precision for a single object detection class
run_eval_det: run eval_det to compute precision, recall, and average precision for multiple object detection classes
run_eval_det_multiprocessing: run eval_det_multiprocessing to compute multi-class detection metrics in parallel using 10 worker processes
run_voc_ap: run voc_ap to compute VOC average precision from recall and precision arrays using 11-point or interpolated method
run_get_iou_obb: run get_iou_obb to compute the 3D oriented bounding box IoU between two 3D bounding boxes
